rows.observation: float32 concatenation of task.get_observation dictionary values; info separately exports qpos/qvel; observation is not restore state.

action.interpretation: action.astype(spec.dtype), linear action_scale.Wrapper mapping to upstream controls; SWM does not clip explicitly.
action.early_break: Only _is_terminated returns true; base False; Reacher qpos_match override.

reset.semantics: Reset/reseed Variation, modify MJCF, compile if dirty, clear cumulative reward, apply runtime variation, seed task RandomState if supplied, env.reset, optional qpos/qvel overwrite.
reset.rng: Task RandomState(seed); Variation seeded by same reset seed. DMC implicit reset can consume task RNG later.
reset.current_stable_reset: Base reset calls sample_states; DMC sample_states draws upstream resets followed by 0..39 random steps. This is not SWM initial-state distribution.

step.semantics: Two underlying DMC steps, sum rewards (None -> 0), accumulate score; last observation returned.
step.reward: sum of task.get_reward across repeats for exact task above
step.truncated: False from SWM; no TimeLimit in these SWM registrations
